issue.title: Modernize eat.md into a hub note and surface eat.base
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-f.1 (epic bob-cli-f, Modernize the quote.md and podcasts.md vault notes).

Evidence (re-verified 2026-08-06 by the bob-cli-f land agent against the live ~/bob vault):
- 'grep -rn "eat\.base" --include=*.md ~/bob' => 0 hits. The restaurant dashboard is only reachable by opening the .base file directly; it is embedded in no note, not even dash.md (which embeds projects.base and refs.base).
- ~/bob/eat.md is still raw zorg conversion output: the 8-line zorg_* frontmatter block, 'parent: [[h2_role]]' unquoted, a '#eat | Notes' bare first line, '# ----- TABLE -----' banners, 'NNNNNN#XX' prefixes, 'ID::'/'LID::' declarations, and ^z- anchors.
- ~/bob/eat/ already holds 92 per-restaurant notes with the modern schema (parent/type/title/status/source_* frontmatter), so the entity extraction eat.md needs is already done - only the hub note was never modernized.

Scope: apply the podcasts.md treatment to eat.md - drop the zorg_* frontmatter, use quoted-wikilink parent, add a '# Restaurants' heading and Related notes list, embed '![[eat.base]]', replace the zorg tables with links to the existing eat/<slug> notes, and carry every existing ^z- anchor onto its new line so inbound block references keep resolving (check inbound refs first: 'grep -rho "\[\[eat#\^" --include=*.md ~/bob'; eat.md self-references at least one, e.g. [[eat#^z-240608-0a]]). Also consider whether eat.base and podcasts.base belong in dash.md alongside projects.base/refs.base. maybe_eat.md and drink.md are related notes to consider but may stay out of scope.

Impact: eat.md is the vault's largest remaining un-modernized zorg hub note, and its Base is invisible.

Caution: writes go to the LIVE vault at ~/bob/ (not the sase clone); snapshot before rewriting and do not commit there - 'bob bulk-git-commit' owns vault commits.
